title: Remove Caffeine AI credit and add contributor names

requirements.text: Remove the text 'تم إنشاء من طرف caffeine ai' (created by Caffeine AI) from the footer or any visible location where it appears

quotes: احذف تم انسان من طرف caffeine ai

acceptanceCriteria: No Caffeine AI credit text appears anywhere on the website
The removal does not break the footer layout or styling

requirements.text: Add a contributors or credits section in the footer displaying the following names: Youcef Senassia, Hamo Abdou, Hosam Chaili, and Yasser Belbahir

quotes: اضف هده أسماء Youcef Senassia Hamo abdou Hosam chaili Yasser belbahir

acceptanceCriteria: All four contributor names are displayed in the footer
Names are formatted consistently and legibly
The contributors section integrates visually with the existing footer design using forest green and desert sand color scheme

constraints: Maintain the existing footer structure and navigation links
Preserve the forest green and desert sand color scheme
nonGoals: Changing the header or any other sections beyond the footer
Adding biographical information or links for the contributors
Translating other site content to Arabic
